title: Thomas

caption:
Part 3. Thomas never got a single letter. 🌹

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Evelyn's letter vanished from the new mailbox, and a lamp burned in the window of a house empty since 1975.
scenes.image: a lamp glowing in the upstairs window of a boarded-up house in fog

scenes.narration: Ben pounded on the boards until the lamp went out. Nobody answered.
scenes.image: a mail carrier knocking on a boarded-up door in the grey morning rain

scenes.narration: The neighbor across the street watched him from her porch. If you want Tom Bell, she said, he's at the river. Every afternoon. Rain or shine.
scenes.image: an elderly woman on a porch in a cardigan, pointing down the street

scenes.narration: Ben found him on a bench by the old stone bridge. Eighty years old. Camel coat. Feeding bread to ducks who weren't there.
scenes.image: an old man in a camel coat on a bench by a misty river, tossing bread onto empty water

scenes.narration: Ben asked if he knew someone named Evelyn. The old man's hands stopped moving.
scenes.image: close-up of an old man's weathered hands frozen mid-motion, holding bread

scenes.narration: She left, he said. February, 1975. Not a word. Not one letter. I waited my whole life for one letter.
scenes.image: an old man staring at the river with wet eyes, a stone bridge in the fog behind him

scenes.narration: Ben handed him that morning's envelope. Cream. Red wax. Roses.
scenes.image: a mail carrier holding out a cream envelope with a red seal to an old man on a bench

scenes.narration: Thomas opened it like it might break. He read it twice. Then he pressed it against his chest and closed his eyes.
scenes.image: an old man holding a letter to his chest, eyes closed, rain beading on his coat

scenes.narration: She wrote to me, he whispered. She never stopped writing.
scenes.image: close-up of an old man's face crumpling into a smile and tears

scenes.narration: Then he looked up at Ben, very calmly, and asked: son, what year do you think it is?
scenes.image: an old man on a riverside bench looking straight at the camera, the fog thickening behind him
